text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I was thinking of putting up my
posters
for my concert here, but what do
you think?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Us students are always checking here for
the
latest news, so surely everyone will
see it,
right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Plus, all the students who find out they
need to
take supplementary lessons will
cheer up when
they see my peppy
poster!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, but what if... I need to take

supplementary lessons too...
